prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 医院门诊医生排班表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "心血管内科" spans 1 col × 3 row; "内分泌科" spans 1 col × 2 row; "骨科" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "科室" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "医生" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "职称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "出诊时间" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 5: header "擅长领域" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1042px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助患者按科室查找医生，了解其职称、出诊时间和擅长领域。","reading":"读者通常先定位科室，再逐行比较医生、出诊时间与专长；合并的科室单元格将同科医生组织成组，每位医生的一行应保持清晰可辨。","groups":["科室、医生和职称共同标识医生及其专业资历。","出诊时间和擅长领域共同帮助患者判断何时就诊以及医生是否适合自己的病情。"],"keep_intact":["医生姓名和职称应尽量保持在一行。","出诊时间中的单个星期与时段组合应保持完整，便于准确识别。","科室名称应尽量保持完整，尤其是合并单元格中的科室名称。"],"may_wrap":["擅长领域是较长的连续描述，可在自然语义位置换行，并利用每位医生行内增加的高度。","出诊时间可在不同出诊时段之间换行；专长描述造成的行高通常可以容纳这些换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [98, 67, 98, 105, 351] · table 720×640px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [98, 67, 98, 159, 297] · table 720×779px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [98, 67, 98, 98, 358] · table 720×640px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"科室、姓名和职称均完整显示；出诊时间按时段分成两行，每位医生的排班容易辨认。专长列较宽，大多数描述占三行，行与科室分组清楚。","problems":"首位医生的专长末行只有“项目多项。”，段落收尾偏短；时间列两行内容后也留有较多空白。","cause":"专长列宽351px，首条描述略超三行容量；时间列宽105px，不足以将两个时段排在一行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"出诊时间完整显示在一行，便于横向比较；科室、姓名和职称也都保持完整。","problems":"专长描述每行较短，七位医生的行均增至四行，左侧各列因此出现大片空白，整表的纵向节奏松散，连续阅读专长也更费力。","cause":"时间列宽159px，容纳了整条排班，但将专长列压缩至297px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"科室、姓名和职称完整；排班按时段换行，与医生行对应清楚。358px的专长列使大多数描述保持三行，整体较紧凑。","problems":"首条专长末行仅有“项。”，形成明显的孤行；时间列相较r1A更窄，但换行方式没有改善。","cause":"专长列宽358px，首条描述恰好溢出极少量文字；时间列宽98px仍只能容纳一个时段一行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2-wide-specialty","widths":[98,67,98,90,366],"change":"将时间列收至90px，把空间让给专长列；尝试消除首条专长的孤行，同时保留每个出诊时段的完整性。"},{"name":"r2-balanced","widths":[98,67,98,113,343],"change":"适度加宽时间列，给时段和标点更多余量，同时保留较宽的专长列；检验描述换行是否比r1A更均衡。"},{"name":"r2-one-line-time","widths":[98,67,98,150,306],"change":"尝试用较r1B略窄的时间列容纳完整排班，把省出的宽度分给专长列，检验能否兼顾单行时间和更舒展的描述。"}]}
